newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Mortar fire and shooting in Sierra Leone capital.
newsitem.headline: Mortar fire and shooting in Sierra Leone capital.

text.p: Heavy mortar fire and shooting broke out in Sierra Leone's capital Freetown late on Tuesday, causing panic in the city where many fear a Nigerian attack to restore ousted president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah, witnesses said.

A spokesman for the May 25 coupmakers said the incident, which lasted 10 minutes, followed a quarrel between Sierra Leonian and Nigerian soldiers at the island airport of Lungi off the capital. There was no immediate confirmation of this.
